description: テストベース文書群からID・画面要素・遷移・数量パラメータ・改訂宣言を自前抽出し、同一対象について複数箇所が異なることを言っている差分候補を決定的に列挙する。矛盾か否かの判定は行わず、候補・確信度・根拠位置の提示までを担う。

completedTools.description: Already executed tools; entries without evidence are treated as not executed

evidence.description: Evidence of execution: an output file path (e.g. docs/test-cases.md) or an output heading line starting with '#'

outputExcerpt.description: Excerpt of the declared tool's actual output text. Must contain that tool's own H1 heading line; otherwise the declaration is reported as evidence-unverified and still counted as not executed

toolName.description: Name of an already executed tool in this workflow

declaredEntities.description: Caller-declared id-to-name catalog. If omitted, list-row declarations extracted from the documents are treated as the declared side

id.description: Entity id, e.g. a screen or feature id

kind.description: Optional entity kind, e.g. screen / feature

name.description: Name declared by the caller for this id

sourceDocument.description: Optional document name this declaration came from

documents.description: Test basis documents to extract IDs, UI elements, transitions, parameters and revision claims from

content.description: Free-text document content (Markdown / plain text, format agnostic)

idPatterns.description: Extra regular expression sources for requirement/feature IDs, added to the default pattern. Capture group count decides how the ID is built: 1 group = group 1 is used as the whole ID as-is (no hyphen joining), 2 groups = reconstructed as `${group1}-${group2}` (default pattern behavior), 0 groups = the whole match is used. Use a 1-group pattern for numeric-only IDs (031), dot-separated IDs (3.1.2) and underscore IDs (REQ_001) so the reported ID matches the notation in the source document. If a given pattern matches nothing, a [high] finding is emitted in the input digest.

knownResolved.description: Subjects already judged resolved/intentional, excluded from candidates and listed with reasons in 1.3

reason.description: Reason why this subject is already resolved or intentional

subject.description: Candidate subject already judged resolved or intentional

minConfidence.description: Minimum confidence of candidates to include in the output (default: low, i.e. all candidates)

relativeTargetTerms.description: Additional relative transition-target terms, appended to the default list

verbose.description: If false/omitted (default), sections 1.3/1.4, each check section in chapter 2 and the 2.12 priority list are truncated to a fixed number of rows with total/omitted counts noted. If true, lists every row in full (as in previous versions).
